# Tarlu

> Third-party logistics (3PL) provider for ecommerce brands. UK and EU warehousing, precision fulfilment, and end-to-end business support. Head office in Poole, Dorset, United Kingdom.

Tarlu Ltd operates fulfilment centres across the UK and EU, serving ecommerce brands that need reliable inbound handling, secure storage, value-added services, and multi-carrier dispatch. Facilities are Soil Association accredited and HMRC Fulfilment House registered. Same-day dispatch cut-off is 3pm and pick accuracy runs at 99.9%.

The site is currently a preview build hosted on GitHub Pages while the redesign of tarlu.com is being validated. All pages ship with structured data (Organization, LocalBusiness, Service, BreadcrumbList, FAQPage) even though search indexing is disabled during preview.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://gustavo-git2806.github.io/tarlu-preview/index.html): Company overview, testimonials, and primary value proposition for ambitious ecommerce brands.
- [Services](https://gustavo-git2806.github.io/tarlu-preview/services.html): Full catalogue of 14 fulfilment services grouped into Inbound & storage, Value-added, Pick pack & dispatch, and UK business support. Includes FAQ section.
- [Markets](https://gustavo-git2806.github.io/tarlu-preview/markets.html): 15+ industry sectors served, from health and wellness to sustainable brands.
- [Contact](https://gustavo-git2806.github.io/tarlu-preview/contact.html): Enquiry form, phone, email and head office address. One working day response commitment.

## Service details

- [Inbound & storage](https://gustavo-git2806.github.io/tarlu-preview/services.html#grp-01): Goods-in processing, secure storage (ambient, bonded, food-grade), quality control.
- [Value-added services](https://gustavo-git2806.github.io/tarlu-preview/services.html#grp-02): Assembly & kitting, bespoke packaging, freight forwarding, goods-in-transit insurance.
- [Pick, pack & dispatch](https://gustavo-git2806.github.io/tarlu-preview/services.html#grp-03): Order picking & packing, gift boxing, personalised despatch messages, courier integration (Royal Mail, DPD, DHL, UPS, FedEx, Evri, Parcelforce).
- [UK business support](https://gustavo-git2806.github.io/tarlu-preview/services.html#grp-04): UK VAT & EORI registration, company formation, import & customs compliance.

## Pricing schedules

- [Advanced pick services (current)](https://gustavo-git2806.github.io/tarlu-preview/advanced-pick-services.html): Per-item pricing for heavy goods, oversized goods, serial and batch tracking.
- [Advanced pick services (2026)](https://gustavo-git2806.github.io/tarlu-preview/advanced-pick-services-2026.html): 2026 pricing schedule for advanced pick services.
- [Packing fees](https://gustavo-git2806.github.io/tarlu-preview/packing-fees.html): Transparent fees for mailing bags, padded envelopes, boxes, void fill, pallets, and eco-friendly options.
- [Fulfilment service surcharges (current)](https://gustavo-git2806.github.io/tarlu-preview/fulfilment-service-surcharges.html): Surcharges for goods-in, storage, picking, packing, shipping, returns, stock checks.
- [Fulfilment service surcharges (2026)](https://gustavo-git2806.github.io/tarlu-preview/fulfilment-service-surcharges-2026.html): 2026 surcharge schedule.
- [Client-supplied packaging](https://gustavo-git2806.github.io/tarlu-preview/client-supplied-packaging.html): Requirements, fees, and setup for clients supplying their own branded packaging.
